notes.title: Engine update
notes.content:
[h2]-Change Log-[/h2]
The update fixes all reported bugs and crashes. The game was stuck in a very old, unsupported version of the Monogame engine, and by porting it, I can now support the game again.

[list]
[*] Updated the engine to the latest Monogame version.
[*] Updated to .NET 8.
[*] Removed online multiplayer and fixed the join crash issue.
[*] Removed Steam controller support.
[*] Removed PlayStation controller mapping.
[*] Old saves are reset (does not change much)
[/list]

[h2]Try out my latest game[/h2]
A real-time grand strategy game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1223150/DSS_war_party/

notes.title: Party Jousting Relaunch! - 3 new modes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11883238/93a20d2101d0521df2c23271ac96a8ea29acd290.jpg[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11883238/c41d1941daa2839d3658cab2be4688156497d0e2.jpg[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11883238/324321baf0ff5960c4ddcd99afbc2892ac8f68fd.jpg[/img]
Today I have a simultaneous Xbox ONE launch and a Steam relaunch.

Going from what was basically a begging monetization, to "One mode for free - all the rest is paid with one DLC".

Three new modes
[list]
[*]Golf 
[*]Car-ball
[*]Match3/Tetris
[/list]

All modes can be played with one button!

Youtuber that tries the new modes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=chbarW_SPLI

notes.title: Update - Air trick, Achievements, 32bit support
notes.content:

notes.title: Beta Update - Space Pirate is back
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/v7N5i5Q.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fbWjLaM.jpg[/img]

Tetris mode has got a lot of tweaks to the brick drops and gray block punishments.

Many testers have requested that I should give the space mode a second chance. The shops uses tickets now (25coins > 1 ticket) and the shields are improved. It is much easier to stay alive now - maybe too easy.

notes.title: Patch - SharpDX removed, Space Pirate cancelled
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VCgGe6l.jpg[/img]

SharpDX, that supports all weird controllers, is removed. It gave to many issues, as giving people double controller input. Will still support Xbox and PS4 controller - which is supported by monogame itself.

In beta:
Testing a few new things in CarBall mode, you can now become a goalie.
The tetris mode now supports competitive play, combos will give punishing bricks to your opponents.
Ive cancelled the development of the Space Pirate mode. Non of the playtesters enjoyed it, and considering how much extra work a big online mode is - it has to be perfect.

Golf has bombs and spikes - for that sweet multiplayer salt.

Beta is available for users with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/442830] Bling DLC.[/url]

notes.title: Changed engine
notes.content:
Converted to MONOGAME/OpenGL (from XNA/DirectX)
Locked to 64bit OS (wont work on win xp/vista anymore)
Removed ability to join with controller sticks/Dpad
Removed native Steam controller support (not worth all the extra work)
Added multi screen support

There has been a lot of hassle with getting the controllers work, if you get any issues - print screen the input Debug screen (see options) and post it.

notes.title: Working on a big update - will take time.
notes.content:
Many players are waiting for the next update, specially the promised online multiplayer.
I am currently working on these features:
[list]
    [*]Strategy-mode, 2-16player + online
    [*]Racing mode, 2-16player
    [*]A huge online versus mode for 1-80players
    [*]Single player campaign with levels and bosses, 2-4p coop + online
[/list] 
Lots of work, in combination that I need a full time job on the side so I afford living. So the update will probably take about 2years to complete.

I will make a few small updates in the meantime to keep the game bug-free and running.

notes.title: Release notes
notes.content:
Party Jousting started as a joke in spring-2014, and quickly became very popular among my friends. The original game was developed in five days. The original art and characters where all made with my iPad, on a boring bus-trip.
I released it on Xbox360, under the game "Failing Bird". It reached number one top selling in Europe, and has been my most 'income gained/time spent' game.

The game has always been a huge success on game conventions, and each time people tell me it is the most fun they ever had with a game (there is a lot of other games that are more fun than mine, I have no delusions about that).

I hope you enjoy it too!

//Fabian Viking
